entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. Prismatic Wall: upright opaque slab of seven parallel luminous sheets red orange yellow green blue indigo violet, slight oblique view shows layered depth, compact rectangular silhouette above a small stone plinth, no hand, no fan rays, no text.
entries.revision: Edit ONLY the attached selected illustration. Preserve its exact artistic concept: seven upright overlapping rectangular monochrome magical sheets, front red, then orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet. Preserve horizontal top/bottom edges, vertical sides, the front red full face and the receding up-right arrangement, crystalline glow and fine crossing magical veins. Make ONLY these changes: 1) compress the depth spacing so the seven layers are tightly touching face-to-face, like a compact stack of seven colored glass plates, NOT a spread-out exploded diagram. Reduce each successive up-right offset substantially, while retaining a clearly visible narrow continuous top-and-right border of each of the six rear colors. There must remain exactly seven distinct countable layers. The front sheet remains entirely red; do not replace it with rainbow stripes or a gradient. 2) REMOVE EVERY loose gemstone, rock, crystal fragment, ground particle and all ground fog below/around the sheets. Nothing beneath them, no pedestal or floor. Clean transparent background with only a subtle thin glow attached to the sheet edges. No detached debris. Do not rotate into a new viewpoint, do not turn into a solid rainbow-striped slab. Keep generous transparent margins, no text.
